initial_input: I want to explore the idea along with the agents the framework to have another functionality - workflows. A workflow should define a process, set of steps which one or several agents should perform in coordination and dependency from each other. I am not sure if this idea is good and how to realize it, so I need your advise, I need you to check the best practices. Make independent recomendation from user perspective, HAI integrity perspective, future scalability perspective, maintainability perspective. Research if similar products have such or close to this functionality and how this is realized there. Be critical.

provenance.reason: Research and critically assess workflow functionality
